experiments.scope: One 256-message bit-sliced evaluation per organizer request. Compare every complete digest with an independent scalar reference, test transpose involution and count logical operations in padding-specialized first and output-projected last rounds. Returns null witnesses; no collision search is performed.
experiments.hypothesis: The specialized Boolean circuit computes the exact complete six-round SHA3-256 digest for the tested 64-byte messages; actual first-round logical count is 5831 and final-round logical count is at most 2752.
